s1.quote: 80 feet (24 m) of water, the stern in 30 feet (9 m) … 85 feet (26 m) of water … Her bow section is still relatively intact.

s2.quote: The stern sank in 35ft of water … settling at about 90ft … it is considered a fairly safe wreck dive suitable for intermediate to advanced scuba divers.

summary.text: A Royal Mail steamer that broke in two off Salt Island in a hurricane; the stern lies in about 30-35 ft and the intact bow in 80-90 ft, with swim-throughs, making it a signature Caribbean wreck dive.
